identity.title: Debate - Is God Real? William Lane Craig vs Michael Tooley
identity.dateBasis: The supplied drcraigvideos upload description explicitly identifies March 24, 2010, sponsored by Ratio Christi at University of North Carolina, Charlotte. Upload publication date is October 10, 2011 and is not the event date.
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: Named introductions, announced opening/rebuttal/closing order, speaker-addressed audience questions, explicit counter-response handoffs, and controller review of all 3,349 caption events.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: Captions cover the introductory welcome at 00:26 through closing logistics at 2:17:11, ending 1.441 seconds before media duration. No gap exceeds 30 seconds. Both openings, two rebuttal rounds, closings and the complete primary-speaker audience-question responses are included. Introductions, applause, logistics, and audience premises are unscored context; no substantive round is excluded.
content.captionCaution: Recognition errors in names, technical terms, negation, mathematical expressions and citations are not participant errors. Exact source text remains unchanged; materially unresolved attribution or load-bearing wording requires verification before assessment.

participants.questionHandling: Audience members pose questions; only the two primary speakers develop sustained cases. Questions, including brief requests for clarification, are context. Moderator administers timing and handoffs, without an independent argument. Both primary answers and counter-responses remain eligible.

duplicateAudit.method: Compared supplied video ID, canonical URL and Craig–Tooley identity against the current 274-debate catalogue and standalone registry; no Tooley entry found.
